fact: The Ministry of Gender Equality, Poverty Eradication and Social Welfare reports its central Information Management System, with an Integrated Social Assistance System module and an Integrated Beneficiary Registry module, as launched and piloted by June 2022 and the activity as Complete.
The Ministry states the central Information Management System holds all social grant beneficiaries and was to integrate data with the GIPF, SSC, ITAS, IFMS and Veteran Affairs System databases.
